name: Arena Rocco
note: The tree gives Rocco Arena b.1861 as the son of ORAZIO Arena and GIOVANA ZIRILLI. The index gives GIUSEPPE and GRAZIA ZIRILLI. The mother's surname — Zirilli, not a common name — matches; both forenames do not. Either the tree has the forenames wrong, which it has repeatedly elsewhere, or this is a different Rocco Arena. Read the act itself before joining.
